summary: The contract is well-grounded: every acceptance criterion, rule, gap and endpoint traces to the cited lines with matching values. The Product Owner's correction (Not Found link now points to /invalid-url instead of /not-found) is applied consistently and correctly everywhere it should be (AC-4, AC-5, AC-8, R1, the endpoints list, and gap G1), while AC-1 and AC-7 are correctly left unaffected since they reference only the link's label, not its endpoint. No requirement-bearing lines were found uncaptured; one minor observation was raised about an unstated inference in testData.
